verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents Custom Integrations for creating and mapping custom resources from tools it has no native integration with, and lets you push raw data via an API endpoint or CSV upload, which it then normalizes, maps and tests. This sits on a documented REST API with a published OpenAPI 3.0 reference and a backwards-compatibility versioning policy. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of pushing externally produced test results or evidence artifacts (pushed data is described as raw resources that Secureframe tests itself), and independent or hands-on corroboration of building a custom integration.
